# Class: Orchestrator

Defined in: [core/specification/shared/orchestrator.ts:48](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/core/specification/shared/orchestrator.ts#L48)

Integration: starts services via testcontainers.
E2E: runs full docker compose up.
